q1_issues.issue: The coordinated definite plural "the cities of Erbil and Suleimaniya" gets no group witness and no PartOf links; two Theme atoms on a single visit event is not a licensed shape for a coordinated object (distributive default = one event per conjunct; group reading = GroupOf plus PartOf members, as multiple same-role atoms are licensed only for collective Agent).
Same defect on the second conjunct - suleimaniya is attached as a second Theme on the one event instead of via a group or its own replicated event.

q2_gaps: discourse-anaphoric "Elsewhere" (contrast with a location mentioned outside this sentence) has no licensed carrier

attributive adjectives on a reified event noun ("a brief, low-profile visit") - Duration and Manner cover adverbs only, so there is no rule for adjectival modifiers of an event-denoting noun; the parse falls back on (Member sk_visit_1 brief)

support-verb plus event-noun object ("paid a visit to X") - the light-verb rule names only occur / happen / take place and leaves the role of the "to"-destination unsettled (Goal vs Theme vs the To oblique)
notes: The name symbol and Name string for "L. Paul Bremer III", the past-wrapped appositive typing, and the american_administrator genus plus predicable-nationality modifier genus are all correct. "Elsewhere in the north" is reasonably rendered as a typed region witness with Location on the event, with nothing invented about where that region is.
